description: Return the authorized account: email address plus total message/thread counts, and WHICH SERVER is answering: `serverVersion` (the bare version ONLY for a release build; anything else names its commit, e.g. `0.23.0+a5ff4a7`, `+a5ff4a7.dirty` when built from uncommitted sources, `+unknown` when the build left no record), `build` (commit, dirty, release, builtAt; absent when unknown), `serverPath` (the directory the running code was loaded from — an npm install, an npx cache or a clone's `dist/`) and `account` (the named mailwarden account, or `(default)`). USE WHEN: confirming WHICH mailbox is connected before a bulk or filter action, as a cheap liveness check, or when a tool or field documented for a version seems missing — `serverVersion` says whether the running build is the one you think, and `serverPath` which install it is. DO NOT USE: to enumerate messages — this returns only counts, not a listing (use search). SIDE EFFECTS: none.
name: get_profile
